text:
Oliver: Heads-up — noticed a ~2x token bump for a subset of tenants after the routing-tag join rollout this morning. billing previews showing duplicates. anyone watching invoices?
Tia: Hmm, saw a spike alert an hour ago but assumed sampling noise. which tenants?
Oliver: tenant ids: t-342, t-812, t-199. spike aligns with 07:12 UTC deploy. deploy-bot says canary -> prod at 07:10 :deploy: 
deploy-bot: canary rollout v0.43 -> v0.44 completed at 07:10 UTC (route-enrich change)
Ben: that version concatenates fallback route tags in the enrich step — could be doubling route attribution when fallback triggers.
Sam: if enrich is appending instead of replacing, downstream metering might treat each tag as separate route and double-count tokens.
Lina: quick check: kafka stream shows pair of events for same request_id?
Oliver: logs snippet: 
```
2026-03-22T07:12:34Z INFO route_enrich request_id=abc123 tags=[route-a]
2026-03-22T07:12:34Z INFO route_enrich fallback applied request_id=abc123 tags=[route-a, route-a_fallback]
2026-03-22T07:12:34Z INFO metering emitted event request_id=abc123 tokens=120 route_tag=route-a
2026-03-22T07:12:34Z INFO metering emitted event request_id=abc123 tokens=120 route_tag=route-a_fallback
```
Tia: yep that looks like duplicate downstream events. metering pipeline treats route_tag as primary key in aggregation. duplicates => doubled tokens.
Ben: immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback v0.44, 2) patch enrich to dedupe tags, 3) add de-dupe in metering consumer (cheap rule).
Sam: rollback buys time but we should prefer consumer-side dedupe as a stopgap (idempotency by request_id+window). then patch enrich to not duplicate.
Lina: consumer-side dedupe note: we already have a short caching TTL for idempotency key (60s). can we extend to 5m for safety? concern: memory pressure on hot partitions.
Ben: extend is fine for now if we target affected tenants' partitions only. we can scope via tenant list.
Oliver: who can flip the consumer TTL and push a canary? I'm on call but can help coordinate.
Tia: I can open a quick PR to set TTL=300s behind a feature flag and roll to 10% then 100%.
Sam: also create a lightweight reconciliation job to scan last 6 hours for duplicated request_ids with equal tokens and mark invoice preview adjustments. we need an audit so customers don't get surprised.
Lina: agree. will start a Rocket ticket for reconciliation and add a dashboard card for duplicate-event-rate by tenant.
Oliver: action list: 
- Tia: PR to extend idempotency TTL + feature flag (canary 10%)
- Ben: small enrich patch to dedupe tags (non-breaking)
- Sam: reconciliation job sketch + invoice adjustments runbook
- Lina: dashboard card + alerts on duplicate-event-rate > 0.5%
- Me: notify CS + finance and draft customer communication if we need to adjust invoices

Tia: tagging @Ben @Sam for review, will link PR in thread. :thumbsup:
Ben: ack, taking the enrich patch now.
Sam: ack, will draft recon job and runbook.
Oliver: thanks all. if we see duplicates continue after consumer TTL change we rollback.
Lina: posting a proto dashboard query in case helpful:
```sql
SELECT tenant_id, count(*) as dup_events, sum(tokens) as dup_tokens
FROM metering.events
WHERE event_time > now() - interval '6 hours'
  AND request_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM metering.events GROUP BY request_id HAVING count(*) > 1)
GROUP BY tenant_id
ORDER BY dup_tokens DESC
```
Tia: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/metering/pull/814 (WIP)
Ben: patch pushed to branch/enrich-dedupe, adding tests.
Sam: recon job ticket: RN-4983, linking invoices team.
Oliver: I'll ping finance in #finance and CS in #customer-success. keep updates in this thread. :lock:
